Although the form itself is about precision, the texture is all about rhythm. I’m not worried about symmetry here, I’m chasing feeling. That raw, tactile surface that invites you to turn the piece over in your hands. The formation of a colossal four-layer assembled porcelain vat in Jingdezhen: a giant ceramic vessel over two meters in diameter, constructed by joining four layers. Several artisans work in tandem—adding water, applying slip, aligning sections, and trimming the坯 (green body)—gradually refining it into smooth, flowing curves.
